en.summary: Return to Tristram for an expanded adventure: 29 character paths, thousands of equipment bases, spells, talents and challenges. Gather up to four players in the online community hub and continue your journey in the Returns from Darkness HD Windows client.
vision: The silence of Tristram. The cathedral door. The feeling of descending one more floor with friends.

Rediscover the classic with deeper character builds, exploration and equipment. Accounts, chat and rooms meet in one community hub; each group has its own adventure under the Returns from Darkness identity.
pillars: 29 character paths
Six archetypes and 29 classes and specializations. Combine attributes, talents and traits to develop your combat style.
A deeper arsenal
Over 2,500 equipment bases, affixes, rarities, gems and upgrades. Organize your collection in an expanded stash and discover new combinations.
More challenges
Spells, bosses, creatures, quests and areas expand the journey. Rules such as Hardcore, Ironman and Survival, plus the Coliseum, offer additional client challenges.
now: Windows client with an integrated hub, cooperative rooms for up to four players, automatic updates and separate account profiles. The item system shares room drops; automatic saving preserves inventory, gold and character development on this computer. The Sanctuary brings together public profiles, characters, portraits, titles and campaign seals. Progress through play to unlock new classes, traits, modifiers and difficulties; existing characters keep their choices. The first three campaign completions grant dots and a golden portrait. The interface includes project-specific HUD and inventory framing, in-game notices and The First Vigil collection: three relics with original icons and ground sprites, rewarded by specific bosses in Normal campaign mode on Horror. The Sanctuary gains compact navigation, profile tabs and new community artwork. Complete Gothic frames, guardian sculptures and textured surfaces form the new project interface. Health and mana use animated liquid; eight potion slots sit alongside the experience bar. Version 0.4.6 adds an initial language choice, main menus in English and Brazilian Portuguese, and classic soundtrack fallback when the optional music pack is missing. Full campaign translation remains in development. 0.4.12 includes TH3data.mor in the complete installer. The launcher prepares mod data automatically and keeps updates small. DIABDAT.MPQ is imported from the player’s installation or selected during initial setup.
next: 36 new original artworks. From drawing to inventory, a collection takes shape inside Returns from Darkness. Development preview: these 36 items are not yet obtainable in the public version. Original equipped artwork and balance remain in production.
en.limits: The hub uses cloud services; gameplay runs in the clients and requires the room creator to stay connected. Characters save on this computer automatically, with recovery copies. A new room creates a new world. Full HD artwork, host migration and ranked PvP are not yet complete.
milestones: Accounts, channels, chat and rooms are on the website. Keeping the hub accessible does not require the administrator's PC to stay on.
29 character paths, equipment, talents, spells and challenges are part of the current client. The room menu and project identity continue to join the experience.
Full HD, material improvements and an animated logo shape the visual direction. Remastering all artwork and the Ashen Arena remain in development.
faq: How do I start?

Download the Windows client from the hub, sign in and create or choose a room. The room button opens the game, and the internal hub also connects to the community. The launcher checks for the latest version before a new game and imports compatible game files from your installation. Opening the game from the site also signs your account into the in-game hub. Opening the community from a signed-in game or launcher carries your account into the browser. 0.4.12 includes TH3data.mor in the complete installer. The launcher prepares mod data automatically and keeps updates small. DIABDAT.MPQ is imported from the player’s installation or selected during initial setup.
Do I need a server running on my PC?

Accounts, chat and room discovery stay in the cloud. The room creator's client hosts gameplay, using a direct connection when possible and a relay on restrictive networks. The creator must stay in the game; leaving ends the group's session.
Is my character saved?

Yes. Automatic saves during play and on normal exit preserve inventory, gold and character development in a separate account profile on this computer. Updates keep saves separate. Characters do not sync across computers, and the room world is not persistent.
Is the full remaster and Arena finished?

The client supports Full HD resolution. Version 0.4.1 adds original framing and a high-definition stone-and-metal material to the HUD and inventory, plus the icons and ground sprites of The First Vigil's three relics. Environments, characters and monsters still retain much of their classic artwork: the whole-world remaster is not finished. Coliseum is available as a client challenge; a competitive PvP Arena, rankings and project events remain in development.
Was all the content created by Returns from Darkness?

We are a community edition adapted from Diablo/Hellfire and The Hell 3, with foundation credits retained. Most classes, areas, equipment and artwork come from those foundations. Returns from Darkness creates the Sanctuary, online integration, updates and account progression, along with illustrations, an emblem, textured HUD and inventory framing, and The First Vigil's three relics. These original elements are presented as additions to inherited content, without claiming authorship of the whole game.
join: The next chapter begins with the community.
Visit the hub to chat, gather your group and open a game. Follow updates and share your gameplay experiences on Discord.
online: The Sanctuary recreates the social experience of Diabloâ€™s classic Battle.net: sign in, chat in channels, find players, and create or join multiplayer rooms. It is the Returns from Darkness communityâ€™s meeting place to gather your party and continue the adventure in the game.
